goal: Make invariant #4 binding on the legacy Past Replies draft lane: all four handlers across the three legacy draft routes (draft-status GET, draft POST, draft/[responseId] PATCH + DELETE) refuse to surface or act on a moderation-held draft, mirroring the publish gate — closing the item-1 hole of map #710 and unblocking the EDIT_REPLIES_ENABLED production flip.
non_goals: The Reviews list row-state remodel and the answered-row held-draft affordance (#727 — blocked by #723)
Open-flag predicate inventory or consolidation (#725/#730 — these four call sites migrate with the rest later, by design)
Any change to src/lib/moderation/held-draft.ts (imported, not modified)
Any client/UI change — useEditReplyDraft.ts and DraftConflictPanel.tsx stay untouched; today's client handles every new server shape via existing terminal-closable paths
The dedicated hold-gate observability signal (map-level 'Not yet specified' item — graduates into its own ticket)
user_visible_behavior: GET /api/dashboard/past-replies/draft-status: a completed generation that resolves to a moderation-held draft returns { status: 'failed', error: 'held_for_review' } (HTTP 200) and never response_id or response_text (client shows its terminal-closable failure state)

POST /api/dashboard/past-replies/draft: when the existing non-terminal draft is held, returns 409 { error: 'held_for_review' } with NO existing payload (no text, no response_id, no status) instead of 409 draft_already_exists

DELETE /api/dashboard/past-replies/draft/[responseId]: a held pending_approval draft returns 409 { error: 'held_for_review' } and is NOT superseded; DELETE stays idempotent-204 for every non-held case (ticket delta approved 2026-08-09: explicit refusal over silent no-op)

PATCH /api/dashboard/past-replies/draft/[responseId]: a held draft returns 409 { error: 'held_for_review' } and is NOT updated (ticket delta approved 2026-08-09: PATCH gated beyond the ticket's three named sites — same file, same rationale: a server gate cannot depend on a client affordance)
invariants: Invariant #4: a moderation-held draft surfaces neither its text nor any affordance through any owner-facing door — after this change, true for every handler in src/app/api/dashboard/past-replies/
A held draft's text appears in no response body from these four handlers while a flagged_responses row with status='open' exists for it
hasOpenFlag call sites are in-tx and post-FOR-UPDATE (POST/PATCH/DELETE); the read-only poller spells the EXISTS predicate inline per #678 D6 — held-draft.ts stays the semantic owner
Tenant scoping is unchanged: every added query keeps the existing business_id/account_id guards
Closed flags (status != 'open') release the draft: all four handlers behave exactly as today
edge_cases: Existing draft held at a non-terminal status other than pending_approval (approved/edited/awaiting_owner_connect): POST gate applies to ALL non-terminal statuses, not just pending_approval (property test)
draft-status: outbox completed, response row resolved, held → failed/held_for_review; response row missing → existing 404 response_not_found unchanged
draft-status: tenant guards (payload business_id + response business_id) still run BEFORE any held branching — a cross-tenant caller learns nothing, not even heldness
DELETE on a held row: refusal must come before the superseding UPDATE and leave the row byte-identical
PATCH on a held row: refusal comes after the response FOR UPDATE lock (serialized against admin disposition), before the UPDATE
Flag closed between poll ticks: next tick returns the draft normally — no sticky held state server-side
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/app/api/dashboard/past-replies/publish/route.ts:159 — in-tx hasOpenFlag → 409 held_for_review (the gate shape for POST/PATCH/DELETE)
src/app/api/dashboard/reviews/[reviewId]/draft-status/route.ts:67-88 — D6 inline EXISTS on the read path; held → text-free terminal state (the gate shape for the legacy poller)
tests_to_add: returns status failed with error held_for_review and no draft sentinel anywhere in the serialized body when the resolved response has an open moderation flag
returns the draft text when the resolved response's moderation flag is closed
spells the correlated open-flag EXISTS with status open inside the tenant-scoped response lookup
returns 403 with no heldness signal when the held response belongs to another tenant
returns 409 held_for_review without the existing draft payload when the existing draft has an open moderation flag
invariants: no non-terminal status ever leaks existing draft text or response id while an open flag exists
DELETE returns 409 held_for_review and does not supersede a held draft
PATCH returns 409 held_for_review and does not update a held draft
rollback_plan: git revert of the single PR — no migration, no flag change, no client change. EDIT_REPLIES_ENABLED remains absent in production (0 accounts/businesses/reviews), so nothing user-facing changes in prod until the flag flips; the flag flip itself is blocked on this landing.
observability: Hold-gate refusals are observable as HTTP 409 responses on the three mutation handlers in Vercel request logs (status-code level; body error codes are visible to the client, not asserted to appear in logs) — same posture as the existing publish gate, which adds no log line

The dedicated fired/should-not-have-fired signal is deliberately deferred to the map-level observability item (#710 'Not yet specified') and will graduate into its own ticket once #726/#727 settle where the gates live
